instructions_to_main_agent: Build ONLY the SpendGuard LANDING PAGE in React.js.
Ensure top-left SPENDGUARD logo and top-right nav: Product, Trust, Demo, Open Console CTA.
Include Hero section with headline TRUST BEFORE THE TAP and gateway visual metaphor.

Build interactive scroll story sections: Problem statement, Intent Mismatch example (Sony headphones vs generic), Four trust checks (Authority, Intent, Evidence, Behavior), Behavioral risk split-payment sequence, Evidence conflict RTX 4060 vs 3050, Trust Receipt object, Provenance vertical timeline, Future console preview, and Final CTA.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns.
Strictly follow the dark cinematic fintech aesthetic specified in design guidelines.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Never use transition: all; apply specific property transitions.
Include micro-interactions, hover states, and entrance animations.
